status: Engineering preflight and retrospective feasibility study; not a full training protocol or efficacy test

geometry.sampling: One uniform draw from the full 54-candidate bank; reject to identity without resampling. This is a preflight bank, not a claim of optimal magnitude.
geometry.order: Existing RGB/640 letterbox, optional horizontal flip, isotropic resize of the square canvas, integer translation on a fixed 640 canvas
geometry.interpolation: Pillow bilinear; exact slicing for flip and integer placement; fill RGB (114,114,114)
geometry.annotations: Transform every target and every valid non-target annotation with the same continuous-edge affine map; preserve labels, IDs, difficult and truncated flags
geometry.rejection: Any transformed annotation outside the canvas rejects the entire candidate to identity. Never clip/drop a target. Invalid non-target boxes disable geometry for that image and are reported.
geometry.limits: Preserving annotated boxes does not prove label completeness, image realism or learning benefit. Zoom may crop unannotated context. Existing truncated annotations remain flagged. Horizontal reflection does not exchange longitudinal and transverse classes; it preserves their relation to the reflected road.

controller.actions: Eight existing appearance operations times three independently tested levels, 24 actions. Mean the two Gaussian-noise draws within each object; count each reference object once.
controller.pooling: Pool selected-group reference-detected objects per class across class sets, preserving image/object/cluster identities. Reference misses stay in recall diagnostics, not retention denominators.
controller.routing: Intersect admissible actions of the classes in the edited group. Unsupported constituent class means identity.
controller.mixed_veto: For a mixed set, a sufficiently supported constituent class with retention below threshold vetoes that action. Missing direct evidence never certifies a mixed set; flag borrowed evidence. Use the same 16-object/8-cluster rule for direct evidence.
controller.shared_comparator: One global action set: intersection over all four pooled class sets, with the union of all supported mixed-set vetoes removed. Same measurements, thresholds and sampling rule.
controller.sampling: Uniform eligible family, then uniform eligible operation in that family, then uniform eligible tested level for that operation. No largest-level preference and no loss-hardness weighting.
controller.state: Rebuild at each update; no stale carry, threshold relaxation or identity-as-success reporting
controller.limitation: Admissibility is a detector-tolerance measurement, not a semantic guarantee or an estimate of training utility.

retrospective.source: Archived v1 training-only observations, existing renderer and detector trajectories. No new inference or training.
retrospective.bootstrap_interpretation: Selection-frequency sensitivity conditional on observed class support, not a confidence bound or a formal acceptance test; no object-level independence assumption
retrospective.denominators: Report pooled support, available actions, routing coverage over panel groups, borrowed evidence, mixed vetoes, class differentiation and total-variation distance to the shared distribution. Do not reinterpret panel frequencies as training exposure.
not_identified: repeated-panel variability at one fixed model
effect of a new controller on the training trajectory

remote_geometry_check.resources: CPU allocation: 2 CPUs, 8 GB, 1 hour, zero GPUs
remote_geometry_check.manifest_scope: All 26863 training rows, all 54 geometry candidates; no validation/test manifests
remote_geometry_check.pixel_scope: Deterministic subset of 56 training images covering sources, classes, negatives and annotation edge cases; every bank candidate rendered, numerical checks saved; bounded representative contact sheets
remote_geometry_check.raw_inputs: Verify image/XML/RGB hashes using the unchanged v1 reader; preserve input files
remote_geometry_check.outputs: Numerical report, per-source/class acceptance counts, per-image records, contact sheets and a checksum archive. Successful execution is not visual review approval.

deferred.copy_paste: Disabled. Needs reviewed donor/recipient regions, annotation closure, compatible road/camera context and its own correctness checks.
deferred.new_local_blending: Not implemented in this stage; archived observations only support the v1 renderer. Separate pixel/annotation inspection and fresh observations are required before changing it.
deferred.fixed_roi_diagnostic: Not used by this controller and not claimed verified by replay. Implement and validate fixed/mapped ROIs before reporting any new auxiliary-loss comparison.
deferred.training: No optimizer, checkpoint selection, validation tuning or full run in this package.

hard_requirements: no held-out data or modified historical inputs
supported class decisions and their instability explicitly reported
fresh repeated training-only panels on a common frozen detector before relying on the new renderer/controller
measured compute within declared next-stage budget
continuation.decision: If pooled support remains absent, class decisions collapse to a shared policy, or small support perturbations change decisions extensively, diagnose the panel/action design before training. Do not relax thresholds just to pass.
continuation.pilot: After preflight, prepare four matched arms (geometry only, fixed appearance, shared online appearance, class-adaptive appearance), branched from a common warmup checkpoint. Pilot length and cost cap are to be frozen using preflight timings, not selected after seeing pilot AP. Short pilots are for behavior/convergence and cost, not final winners.
continuation.full_run: Requires a reviewed preflight and bounded matched pilot; no automatic submission or escalation to full/multi-seed training.
